mapper.select: SELECT A_MAIN_NO, A_MAIN_TYPE FROM PC_ANIMAL_MAIN ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO
SELECT A_SUB_NO, A_MAIN_NO, A_SUB_TYPE FROM PC_ANIMAL_SUB ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO, A_SUB_NO
SELECT I_MAIN_NO, I_MAIN_TYPE FROM PC_ITEM_MAIN ORDER BY I_MAIN_NO
SELECT I_SUB_NO, I_MAIN_NO, I_SUB_TYPE FROM PC_ITEM_SUB ORDER BY I_MAIN_NO, I_SUB_NO

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.BRAND, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, P.STOCK_QTY, P.PRODUCT_STATUS, DATE_FORMAT(P.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE, AM.A_MAIN_TYPE, ASUB.A_SUB_TYPE, IM.I_MAIN_TYPE, ISUB.I_SUB_TYPE, CONCAT(F.FILE_PATH, F.FILE_NAME) AS MAIN_IMG FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB ASUB ON P.A_SUB_NO = ASUB.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN AM ON ASUB.A_MAIN_NO = AM.A_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB ISUB ON P.I_SUB_NO = ISUB.I_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_MAIN IM ON ISUB.I_MAIN_NO = IM.I_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_NO = F.PRODUCT_NO AND F.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
SELECT FILE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS IMG FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_NO
SELECT FILE_NO, PRODUCT_NO, FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS IMG FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND IS_DETAIL = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_NO
SELECT REVIEW_NO, PRODUCT_NO, USER_ID, RATING, R_CONTENTS AS CONTENTS, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY REVIEW_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) AS REVIEW_AVG FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}

SELECT QNA_NO, PRODUCT_NO, USER_ID, QNA_TITLE, Q_CONTENTS, A_CONTENTS, ANS_STATUS, IS_SECRET, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE, CASE WHEN ADATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(ADATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS ADATE FROM QNA WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY QNA_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QNA ( PRODUCT_NO, USER_ID, QNA_TITLE, Q_CONTENTS, ANS_STATUS, IS_SECRET, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{contents}, 'N', #{secretYn}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO CART ( USER_ID, PRODUCT_NO, QTY, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productNo}, #{qty}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT C.CART_NO, C.PRODUCT_NO, C.QTY, DATE_FORMAT(C.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_PRICE, CONCAT(F.FILE_PATH, F.FILE_NAME) AS MAIN_IMG FROM CART C JOIN PRODUCT P ON C.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON C.PRODUCT_NO = F.PRODUCT_NO AND F.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY C.CART_NO DESC
SELECT CART_NO, USER_ID, PRODUCT_NO, QTY, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE FROM CART WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
SELECT QNA_NO, PRODUCT_NO, USER_ID, QNA_TITLE, Q_CONTENTS, A_CONTENTS, ANS_STATUS, IS_SECRET, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CDATE FROM QNA WHERE QNA_NO = #{qnaNo}
